title: Unstructured library analytics may be on
explanation: The unstructured library sends an analytics ping to packages.unstructured.io when it is imported, and a usage event after partition calls. Setting SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS or DO_NOT_TRACK to any non-empty value turns both off.

evidence.detail: unstructured 0.16.5 installed; not disabled in the image (none of DO_NOT_TRACK=*, SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS=*)

fix: Set SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS=true and DO_NOT_TRACK=true in the image environment.
